articles.title: Hanging glacier above Badrinath could trigger avalanche affecting helipad, roads and nearly 400 buildings: Study
articles.summary: A hanging glacier overlooking Badrinath in Uttarakhand's Chamoli district poses a significant avalanche threat to 398 buildings and critical infrastructure. This includes the helipad, parking areas, and roads in the pilgrimage town. This situation underscores the importance of disaster preparedness and risk mitigation strategies in sensitive Himalayan regions to protect vital national assets.

articles.title: India must build oil reserves, reduce energy imports amid global trade shocks: C Rangarajan
articles.summary: Former RBI Governor C Rangarajan underscored the imperative for India to recalibrate its development strategy. He stressed the need to account for potential global disruptions, such as the economic fallout from a hypothetical blocking of the Strait of Hormuz. This strategic foresight is crucial for safeguarding India's economic resilience and ensuring sustained national growth amid international eventualities.

articles.title: Delhi to Agra in 59 minutes: PM Modi approves north corridor of bullet train project
articles.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi has approved the north corridor of the bullet train project, announced Railway Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw. This significant national infrastructure development is poised to transform the lives of many, expanding India's high-speed rail network. For an SSB aspirant, this highlights critical national development projects and strategic infrastructure planning for future economic growth and connectivity.

articles.title: Where Am I - with Speech
articles.summary: A new mobile application has been developed, primarily catering to the visually impaired, enabling them to easily ascertain their current location. Designed with a remarkably simple and intuitive user interface, it aims to enhance accessibility and independence. While benefiting the visually challenged, it also serves as a straightforward location-finding tool for the general public, demonstrating practical technological innovation.

articles.title: Reactions as Tinubu Chinese tablets go viral
articles.summary: Nigerians are criticizing the alleged production of 40,000 campaign tablets for President Bola Tinubu in China. Critics question why these devices weren't manufactured locally, highlighting concerns over job creation and boosting Nigeria's domestic economy. This incident sparks debate on national economic policy and foreign sourcing for political campaign materials, impacting local industrial growth and employment opportunities.

articles.title: Delhi to Agra in 59 minutes: PM Narendra Modi approves north bullet train corridor connecting Lucknow, Varanasi, Guwahati
articles.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi has approved a significant north bullet train corridor project. This ambitious initiative aims to connect key cities including Delhi, Agra, Lucknow, Varanasi, and Guwahati. A major highlight is the projected travel time of just 59 minutes between Delhi and Agra. This infrastructure development signifies a substantial upgrade in national connectivity and transportation.
